US To Sell $28 Bln In Reopened 1-Year 10-Month FRNs Wed
WASHINGTON (Dow Jones)--The U.S. Treasury plans to auction $28 billion in reopened 1-year 10-month frns Wednesday.
The debt will settle on Sept. 25, 2026 and will mature July 31, 2028.
The debt is a reopening of an issue first sold on July 31, 2026.

Noncompetitive tenders for the 1-year 10-month frns, available in minimum denominations of $100, must be received by 11:00 AM Eastern Time Wednesday. Competitive tenders available in minimum denominations of $100, must be received by 11:30 AM Eastern Time.
(Data provided by the U.S. Treasury Dept.)
